environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. MongoDB 7.0 Enterprise with Queryable Encryption (QE) disabled but with document-level access control via MongoDB Enterprise's Field Level Redaction using $redact aggregation pipeline stage enforced through a custom MongoDB Enterprise Auditing + Realm sync rule. Specifically: a MongoDB Atlas App Services Rule is configured on the 'documents' collection with the template expression: { 'tenant_id': '%%user.data.tenant_id' } which is evaluated server-side by the Atlas Data API layer. The application connects through Atlas Data API (HTTPS endpoint) rather than native driver protocol. The Data API applies the rule BEFORE query execution, injecting an implicit $match stage that cannot be overridden by client-supplied operators. Additionally, the Atlas Data API endpoint has a request validation schema that rejects any request body containing keys starting with '$' at the top level of the 'filter' field beyond $text and $regex.

config.access_layer: Atlas Data API v2 with App Services Rules
config.request_validation: Atlas Data API schema rejects operator keys in nested filter values except $text and $regex
config.connection_method: HTTPS to Atlas Data API endpoint (not native MongoDB wire protocol)
config.network: ECS Fargate -> internal ALB -> Atlas Data API private endpoint
config.native_driver_access: blocked by VPC security group - no port 27017 egress allowed
